name: DC prestige: refused below the required level, then drops the character to the restart level
description: DESTRUCTIVE: performs a real prestige on a dedicated lab character (DC.GameplayTest.AllowDestructive = 1 required). Cleanup puts the prestige level and the character level back and re-teaches class spells; prestige rewards (title, currencies) and the account-wide talent point stay. Needs Prestige.Enable = 1 and Prestige.RequiredLevel <= MaxPlayerLevel.

steps.label: Below the required level the refusal names the level
At the required level nothing refuses
The character restarts at Prestige.ResetLevel (+ Head Start)
The prestige level went up by one
